question:
**Select the sentence containing the homonym of the highlighted word:**

The priest lifted the chalice during the Eucharist.

options.text: The forger crafted a silver chalice with vine engravings.
The noble toasted with a jeweled chalice.
The investor discussed the chalice of currency debasement.
The altar server held the golden chalice reverently.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"chalice"** in the original sentence refers to a goblet or cup, often used in religious ceremonies, especially in Christian rituals. (प्याला)
 
 
• **Example: **The priest raised the chalice during the sacred ceremony.
 
 
• The word **"chalice"** in Option 3 is used metaphorically to mean a "vessel" or "symbol" for something, in this case, the "chalice of currency debasement" represents a figurative concept. (प्रतीक)
 
 
• **Example: **The chalice of responsibility was passed on to the next leader.
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1:** The forger crafted a silver chalice with vine engravings. 
 
 
• **Explanation:** Here, "chalice" refers to a literal cup or goblet, crafted with intricate designs. (प्याला)
 
• **Example:** The museum displayed an ancient silver chalice from the medieval period.
 
 
 
• **Option 2:** The noble toasted with a jeweled chalice.
 
 
• **Explanation:** In this context, "chalice" again refers to a physical cup, richly adorned with jewels. (जड़ा हुआ प्याला)
 
• **Example:** The king raised his jeweled chalice in celebration of the victory.
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** The altar server held the golden chalice reverently.
 
 
• **Explanation:** Here, "chalice" refers to a golden cup used in a religious ritual. (सोने का प्याला)
 
• **Example:** The altar boy carefully placed the golden chalice on the table.
